Subject: Montclair discovery recap + proposed next steps

Hi Liam / Paige — thanks again for taking time earlier today. Quick recap from our 30-min discovery: 

- Montclair is exploring embedded LLM assistance for clinicians in the triage workflow (30–45s response SLO per request).
- Key priorities: PHI handling controls, on-prem / VPC option for audit scope, predictable latency at peak (evening shifts).
- Success metric: 10% reduction in triage time within 3 months of pilot.

Proposed next steps:
1) I’ll send our SOC 2 packet and security summary for your compliance team to review (linked) — Rafael will be available for a technical Q&A.
2) If compliance looks good, schedule a 45-min technical walkthrough with Rafa + your infra lead.
3) Pilot timeline discussion + rough commercial ballpark after we align on security.

Can you confirm who from your side will review the SOC 2 packet (name + email) and any internal timeline constraints? I’ll attach the packet in my next email.

Thanks — Neha
